editorial:
If you are in the mood for a fun, old-school buddy action comedy, this one delivers plenty of laughs and stunts. Jackie Chan plays a determined Hong Kong detective who has spent years chasing a mysterious crime boss known as the Matador. When an American gambler played by Johnny Knoxville gets tangled up in the same case, the two are forced to team up and travel across China and Mongolia. Their constant bickering, wild chases, and over-the-top fight scenes give the movie a lively, easygoing energy that keeps you entertained from start to finish.

The action is classic Jackie Chan, with creative stunts and plenty of physical comedy, while Knoxville brings his usual reckless charm. The pacing moves quickly, and the gorgeous locations add a nice travel-movie feel. On the downside, the plot is pretty thin and some jokes fall flat, but the chemistry between the leads carries it. This is a great pick for a relaxed movie night with friends or family. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the detective finally corners the Matador and learns the crime boss has been hiding in plain sight with help from corrupt officials. After a big showdown, the gambler redeems himself by helping take down the villain and clearing his own name. The detective closes the case he has chased for years, and the two unlikely partners part ways as friends, with the gambler promising to stay out of trouble.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves buddy comedies, Jackie Chan stunts, and lighthearted action movies.
